say:1:1831401001:1.text: You look at the mess of armor and bones before you. This was the skeletal horse Estrilda snatched from Bantus, though it can hardly be called a horse anymore.
say:1:1831401001:1.source_cn: 你看着眼前这堆凌乱的盔甲和骨骼——这是爱丝特瑞达从班题...
say:1:1831401001:1.male: You look at the mess of armor and bones before you. This was the skeletal horse Estrilda snatched from Bantus, though it can hardly be called a horse anymore.
say:1:1831401001:1.female: You look at the mess of armor and bones before you. This was the skeletal horse Estrilda snatched from Bantus, though it can hardly be called a horse anymore.

say:2:1831401002:1.text: Thanks to this horse, Estrilda and Thane survived their fall from the cliff unharmed. Unfortunately, the horse itself wasn't so lucky.
say:2:1831401002:1.source_cn: 多亏了它，从悬崖坠下的爱丝特瑞达和瑟恩才安然无恙。不过...

say:3:1831401003:1.text: You wonder if it could still move if you put it back together.
say:3:1831401003:1.source_cn: 如果将它重新拼凑完整，它还有行动能力吗？你忍不住好奇。
say:3:1831401003:1.male: You wonder if it could still move if you put it back together.
say:3:1831401003:1.female: You wonder if it could still move if you put it back together.

say:4:1831401004:1.text: Give it a try. A little voice in your head urges you on. It's just a horse. It can't tell the living from the Graveborn, friend from foe, and it won't attack you on its own. Worst case, you can just smash it to pieces again.
say:4:1831401004:1.source_cn: 试试吧，试试吧。你心中的声音在诱惑着你。它只是一匹马，...
say:4:1831401004:1.male: Give it a try. A little voice in your head urges you on. It's just a horse. It can't tell the living from the Graveborn, friend from foe, and it won't attack you on its own. Worst case, you can just smash it to pieces again.
say:4:1831401004:1.female: Give it a try. A little voice in your head urges you on. It's just a horse. It can't tell the living from the Graveborn, friend from foe, and it won't attack you on its own. Worst case, you can just smash it to pieces again.

say:5:1831401005:1.text: Curiosity wins out, and you give in, putting the horse back together.
say:5:1831401005:1.source_cn: 好奇心占领了上风，所以你顺从了自己的想法，动手帮它复原。
say:5:1831401005:1.male: Curiosity wins out, and you give in, putting the horse back together.
say:5:1831401005:1.female: Curiosity wins out, and you give in, putting the horse back together.
